articles.title: Hyundai becomes first major South Korean company to introduce internal stablecoin transfers
articles.snippet: The initiative builds on a broader shift by companies exploring stablecoins to move money between international operations more efficiently.

articles.title: Crypto defies equity weakness as altcoin optimism builds into the weekend
articles.snippet: The price of bitcoin hit $64,400, retesting a level it failed to penetrate on Monday, with a break higher opening the path toward the June 15 peak of $67,250.

articles.title: Cambridge study puts Ethereum near the lower end of PoS energy intensity
articles.snippet: Cambridge estimated that Ethereum consumes 7.87 GWh annually and has the second-lowest market-value-adjusted energy intensity among the proof-of-stake networks studied.

articles.title: Empery Digital shares rise after selling BTC to fund AI data center project
articles.snippet: The sales come months after a major Empery shareholder demanded the firm ditch its Bitcoin treasury strategy and sought the resignation of its CEO and board.

articles.title: Bitcoin price gains nearly 10% in July, but traders still see BTC copying 2022 bear market
articles.snippet: Bitcoin price gains approached 10% for the first two weeks of the month, but analysis warned of the bear market returning from August onward.
